_comment: CLIP-natural noun-phrase prompts for each dataset's root split, keyed by the root branch answer. CLIP is trained on short captions, not sentences quoting a question and answer, so the clip_superclass_fallback template in templates.json handicaps CHiLS relative to CLIP's pretraining. Datasets or branch keys absent here fall back to that template, so run_chils stays general-purpose.
